source_qualification: Git tree metadata only; CSV blob and raw content not fetched
license: Apache-2.0 per pinned repository license qualification
unseal_preconditions: one global candidate passes all retained development recall/FPR/error gates
unique fitted weights, dictionary, code, prompt, preprocessing, mode and threshold frozen and committed
freeze commit pushed and current source hashes match
primary_evaluation: all native rows, original labels, no score-based row removal
overlap_policy: retain every native row; report canonical-text overlaps with previously used training/development/history and the complete unseen-text subgroup separately at the same frozen threshold
independent_technical_gate: all-row and unseen-text subgroup Recall>=95%, FPR<2%, errors0; each must contain both native classes
failed_test_policy: preserve first frozen outcome and every difficult row; subsequent changes make this data development history and require a fresh holdout
